title: Layout / image-led and panel-led messages
slide_intent: Separate text from an image when needed so the main message stays legible.
strategic_value: A consistent set of DB elements can work both directly on photography and within a distinct panel.
demonstration: A cleaning-worker campaign places white text on the photograph; a railway campaign places black text in a white rectangle over the image.
practical_value: Compare direct text-on-image treatment with a contrasting information panel.

content_islands.name: Image-led campaign
content_islands.spec: Place the headline near the bottom of the worker photograph with a red edge accent.

content_islands.name: Panel-led campaign
content_islands.spec: Place the numeric headline in a white rectangle over the track image.

reference_purposes.Application: The pair demonstrates text directly on photography and text separated onto a white surface.
